name: 浑天铜签
text: 战斗开始时，收取1张[命签]。每当你[改判]，获得4点[护甲]。
flavor: 浑天仪拆下来的一根铜杆，被他削成了签。

art.subject: a slender bronze rod broken from an armillary sphere, carved into a fortune slip, lying on dark velvet with faint star engravings

name: 龟甲卦筒
text: 每回合你首次打出[延时]牌后，抽1张牌。
flavor: 筒里的龟甲早就裂完了，裂纹比卦辞还多。

art.subject: a worn cylinder made from a tortoise shell, cracked all over, with three bronze coins and a folded talisman peeking out of the top

name: 星盘
text: 每当你进行一次[判定]，获得1点[护甲]。
flavor: 盘上星位一转，灾星便偏开半寸。

art.subject: a round bronze star plate with rotating rings engraved with constellations and trigrams, faintly glowing gold, on dark silk

name: 悬卦钱
flavor: 三枚铜钱系在卦绳上，一枚总是比别的亮。

art.subject: three old bronze divination coins tied on a red cord, one of them shining bright gold, hanging against a night sky
